baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive substitution at focus word 2 governs the twice-named earth and the coordinated heavens.
baseline_models.mechanism: Substitution, explicit otherness, and the lower/upper pair combine into an exchange of the present world-order for a non-identical order.

activation_trace.role: Putting one thing in another's place supplies the governing replacement operation.
Otherness and opposition make the resulting earth non-identical to the named earth.
The lower realm opposed to the sky supplies the substrate named on both sides of the exchange.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper half of the world-order coordinated with earth.

changed_reading.before: A future day brings some unspecified alteration to the earth.
changed_reading.after: The lower and upper world-order is exchanged for an other order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 can denote alteration of form without replacement of substance, while word 4 can denote either alteration or substitution.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same lexical construction that supports numerical replacement also permits radical re-forming: the existing earth and heavens may persist as substrate while becoming other in condition and appearance.

activation_trace.role: Change of image while the underlying thing remains supplies continuity through transformation.
Alteration and exchange remain joined, allowing otherness of state without requiring a new substance.
Repetition of the same lower-realm noun keeps a continuity reading grammatically live.

changed_reading.before: The first earth is removed and an unrelated earth takes its place.
changed_reading.after: The present cosmic substrate may be forced into a radically other form while retaining continuity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 7 moves the plural subjects into visibility before the One and the Subduer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The transformed enclosure becomes an uncovered arena: emergence removes concealment, singular sovereignty removes rival jurisdictions, and overpowering removes resistance.

activation_trace.role: Appearance after concealment supplies compulsory visibility.
An open exposed space supplies the spatial form of the encounter.
Sovereignty without partner removes every competing center before which one might stand.
Overpowering from above makes the exposure irresistible rather than voluntary.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic change is followed by an otherwise separate gathering.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic change produces the unshielded arena in which all resistance and rival jurisdiction disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier creation-removal-arrival-newness sequence gives the focus substitution a succession pattern and weights actual replacement more strongly than mere cosmetic alteration.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies both the existing heavens-earth pair and the category of a successor creation.
Going away supplies removal of the existing bearer before succession.
Arrival supplies the positive introduction of a successor rather than only destruction.
Newness after a severance supplies discontinuity between old and successor.
Replacement in the focus receives the earlier removal-and-successor sequence.

structural_cues: 14:19 names heavens and earth as a created pair, then orders removal before the coming of a new creation.
14:48 repeats the cosmic pair and applies passive substitution to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, removal, arrival, and newness; I project that succession pattern from creatures in 14:19 onto the cosmic pair in 14:48. Radical re-forming of one substrate remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Numerical replacement and continuous re-forming are evenly balanced.
changed_reading.after: A creation-level successor order is now weighted more strongly, while continuous re-forming remains secondary rather than discarded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human beings first install ingratitude where divine benefit stood and conduct their people toward ruin; the later divine substitution replaces the order that hosted that corrupt exchange, on a day when purchase cannot supply an escape.

activation_trace.role: The same replacement operation is first performed by human agents on a divine gift.
Beneficial good condition supplies the displaced term of the human exchange.
Covering a blessing supplies the corrupt replacement installed in its place.
Ruin supplies the destination produced by the corrupt exchange.
The absence of price-based exchange closes a human mechanism for obtaining a substitute outcome.
The focus joins alteration and exchange as the sovereign counter-operation.

structural_cues: 14:28 places human substitution before settlement in the house of ruin.
14:31 anticipates a day with no sale.
14:48 gives the substitution operation to an unstated agent and ends before the One Subduer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition, ruin after human substitution, and a day without sale; I assign the reversal from corrupt human exchange to sovereign counter-exchange. The alternative is that the two uses of substitution are independent.

changed_reading.before: The earth's replacement is a morally neutral material event.
changed_reading.after: The replacement becomes a judicial counter-substitution that closes the world of corrupt exchanges and unavailable escape purchases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Coercive expulsion, divine resettlement after former occupants, and later residence in wrongdoers' dwellings establish landholding as succession rather than ownership; final earth-replacement universalizes the end of tenure.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies coercive eviction from a claimed territory.
The shared lower realm is narrowed by its speakers into a possessive territorial claim.
Settlement in a dwelling supplies a divinely reassigned occupancy.
After-ness orders one occupancy behind another and makes tenure sequential.
Dwelling in former wrongdoers' dwellings makes inherited occupancy visible.
Replacement now operates on the territorial substrate itself, ending every derivative occupancy.

structural_cues: 14:13 opposes expulsion from a possessively named land to forced return into a community.
14:14 promises settlement in the land after the expellers.
14:45 reminds later hearers that they occupied the dwellings of prior wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated eviction and occupancy succession; I infer that replacing earth is the universal termination of provisional tenure. The alternative is a purely cosmic event unrelated to territorial claims.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes impersonal geology changing.
changed_reading.after: The change is also final dispossession: no community owns the ground from which everyone must emerge before the One.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tree contrast distinguishes borrowed physical support from genuine stability: one relation spans rooted origin and elevated branch, another is wholly uprooted and has no resting stability, while divine fixing crosses present and later life.

activation_trace.role: Deep rootedness supplies continuity grounded beneath visible growth.
Durable stability supplies persistence within the earth-sky relation.
A high extension from an origin links the fixed base to the upper realm.
Whole-root extraction supplies loss of every hold on the existing surface.
Stability and settled rest supply precisely what the uprooted structure lacks.
Divine strengthening relocates continuity from physical substrate to an act that spans both lives.
The lower supporting realm is what can be exchanged without exhausting every kind of stability.
The upper pole paired with earth completes the physical coordinate that can be replaced.

structural_cues: 14:24 places a fixed origin below and a branch in the sky.
14:26 removes the corrupt tree from above earth and denies it stability.
14:27 attributes fixing across present and later life directly to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical rooting, complete uprooting, absent stability, and divine fixing; I infer that what survives cosmic replacement is relation to divine fixing rather than attachment to old matter. The alternative is that the tree sequence is only rhetorical and not a continuity model.

changed_reading.before: Replacing earth and heavens means every continuity is erased.
changed_reading.after: Physical coordinates can be replaced while divinely grounded stability persists; the event separates rooted continuity from mere attachment to the old surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invitational movement out of confining darkness into manifest light becomes universal and compulsory: all are gathered into visibility, while denial of hiddenness shows that the exposure changes public manifestation rather than divine knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out of concealment supplies the surah's initial voluntary route toward visibility.
Confinement from truth makes darkness a withholding condition, not only low illumination.
Clarity and emergence supply the manifest endpoint of the initial movement.
The focus verb appears earlier with all subjects, pre-enacting universal appearance.
Joining the dispersed supplies total collection into one field of appearance.
Concealment supplies the condition explicitly denied before God.
Open manifestation supplies the counterpart to what humans hide.
Final emergence makes visibility compulsory after the old enclosure is changed.

structural_cues: 14:1 frames revelation as bringing people from darkness into light.
14:21 repeats emergence before God and adds total gathering.
14:38 pairs what humans hide and disclose, then denies that anything in earth or sky is hidden from God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated concealment-to-manifestation movement and prior divine knowledge; I infer that 14:48 externalizes hidden conditions for creatures rather than informing God. The alternative is simple bodily resurrection without this disclosure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Emergence is merely physical appearance after catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: Emergence is the compulsory completion of the surah's earlier offered passage into manifestation, making already-known realities publicly unshielded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering collapses follower-leader, demonic, and rival-god networks as sources of shelter, but does not merge persons: singular authority faces each self with its own acquisition.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed people supplies one shared field before God.
Lack of power supplies the dependent pole of the failed social hierarchy.
Claimed greatness supplies the hierarchy's elevated pole, now unable to protect followers.
Loyal following supplies the dependency chain whose protection fails.
Sufficiency supplies the help followers seek and leaders cannot provide.
Authority and delegated power supply what the tempter explicitly denies possessing.
Association with God supplies a rival relation repudiated by its supposed beneficiary.
A rival counterpart supplies the competing center negated by the focus title One.
Matching action with recompense supplies individualized judgment after collective gathering.
The thing's own self supplies the irreducible unit that remains after group shelters collapse.
Personal acquisition supplies the causal content carried into judgment.
Partnerless divine unity closes the surah by excluding every rival authority.
Irresistible overcoming enforces the collapse of delegated shelters before singular authority.

structural_cues: 14:21 has the weak ask former leaders for protection after all have emerged together.
14:22 removes the tempter's authority and returns blame to each self.
14:30 names rival counterparts, while 14:51 assigns each self its own earning and 14:52 closes with one deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed dependency chains, denied authority, rejected rivals, and per-self recompense; I infer that One and Subduer operationalize a collapse of intermediary cover without erasing personal identity. The alternative is that these are separate judgment scenes rather than one singularizing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Standing before the One means an undifferentiated mass confronts a sole ruler.
changed_reading.after: Sole rule dismantles every protective network while preserving each self as the bearer of its own acquired account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The current cosmic system is repeatedly subjected for human benefit and runs in habitual service; when that system is replaced, the beneficiary-subject relation reverses and humans themselves stand subdued before God.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the serviceable heavens-earth system as a made order rather than an independent one.
Subjection toward a purpose supplies boats and rivers as services directed to human benefit.
Purposeful subjection extends the service relation to luminaries and the night-day cycle.
Continuous habitual operation supplies the regularity of the present service system.
Overpowering subjection now takes humans, rather than cosmic utilities, as its exposed object.

structural_cues: 14:32-33 repeatedly marks created systems as subjected for human use.
14:48 replaces those systems and shifts the directional phrase from for you to before God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated purposeful subjection for humans and later human appearance before the Subduer; I infer a reversal of beneficiary and subjected object. This is an analogical arrow between distinct roots, and the alternative is simple termination of service rather than inversion.

changed_reading.before: The useful cosmos is replaced while the human relation to it remains unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Replacement ends the human-centered service arrangement and exposes its former beneficiaries as the ones now wholly subjected.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sworn claim of non-cessation and plots imagined at mountain-moving scale are answered by substitution of the ground itself; what humans call immovable is contingent before the Subduer.

activation_trace.role: A distributed oath supplies the force behind the human claim of permanence.
Continuance of state supplies the permanence the speakers claim for themselves.
Departure from place or condition supplies the imagined effect of their plotting.
A raised solid mass supplies the local emblem of apparent immovability.
Replacement of the earth answers local imagined movement with total substrate succession.
Overpowering makes both claimed permanence and mountain-scale manipulation subordinate.

structural_cues: 14:44 recalls a prior oath that the speakers had no cessation.
14:46 places attempted mountain-removal immediately before the promise, vengeance, and focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a permanence claim, imagined mountain movement, and immediate cosmic substitution; I read the latter as an answer that exceeds both. The alternative is that mountain movement only measures plot intensity and has no spatial link to 14:48.

changed_reading.before: World replacement is a generic display of power.
changed_reading.after: World replacement specifically refutes claims of permanence and dwarfs human attempts to manipulate what appears immovable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a branch-distant material sense under the divine title rather than its dominant conquest sense. It remains anchored in focus word 10, the form-changing branch at word 2, and the immediate fire-and-covering scene; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for forced state change, not as the lexical meaning of the title or a description of God.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines form-changing substitution at word 2 with the polyvalent root of the Subduer at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Flesh forced by fire to release moisture and alter supplies a branch-distant phase-change analogy for subduing.
Change of form with possible material continuity supplies the transformation side of the analogy.
A viscous exuding material supplies a heat-responsive bodily envelope.
A covering that overtakes the surface makes exposure paradoxically material and bodily.
Kindled fire supplies the active material agent in the phase-change analogy.

changed_reading.before: Subduing is only a political image of irresistible rule.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, subduing also evokes forced material transition: world and exposed bodies are driven into altered states.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped inventory for the sky root and reads the earth-sky pair as an imprinting system. It remains anchored in focus words 3-6 and in the surah's sky-water-fruit sequence; downstream prose should label it a split-root, ecological sign analogy rather than an etymology or a claim about the replacement earth's physical contents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places an other earth under changed heavens, allowing the lower surface and upper source to be read relationally.

activation_trace.role: First rain leaving visible growth-marks on earth supplies an upper-source-to-lower-surface inscription relation.
Receptive fertile ground supplies the surface capable of bearing a new visible condition.
Beneficial repair through irrigation keeps regenerative otherness live beside punitive replacement.
The same split-root branch is activated where the upper realm supplies rain to the earth.
Delivered water supplies the medium by which the upper source changes the lower surface.
Ripe fruit supplies the visible result carried by the marked and provision-bearing surface.

changed_reading.before: Earth and heavens are two objects independently replaced.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their replacement is a re-inscription of the relation by which an upper order leaves visible consequences on a receptive lower world.

strongest_changes: 14:19 weights creation-level succession over merely cosmetic alteration.
The repeated substitution root turns cosmic replacement into a possible counter-operation against corrupt human exchange.
Eviction, resettlement, and inherited dwellings make earth-replacement the end of every provisional tenure.
Repeated emergence and denied hiddenness make the focus a compulsory public manifestation under singular authority.
The subjecting of the cosmos for humans reverses when former beneficiaries stand before the Subduer.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context converted a bare cosmic scene into several mechanisms at once: successor creation, counter-exchange, final dispossession, nonmaterial continuity, compulsory manifestation, singularized accountability, and reversal of the human-centered service order.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus branches still permit both numerical replacement and radical re-forming of one substrate.
The coordinated heavens may share the earth's substitution directly or enter by compressed parallel syntax.
Counter-exchange, tenure, and beneficiary reversal depend on explicit reader-supplied arrows rather than direct causal grammar.
The two outliers are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified analogies.
